name: Alemannenring (Singen)
notes: Temporary street circuit in Singen's industrial area, first used in 1991 (clockwise): start/finish westbound on the southern carriageway of Georg-Fischer-Strasse, Pegulan-Kurve onto Carl-Benz-Strasse, Grubwaldstrasse, Byk-Gulden-Strasse, Pfaffenhaeule, Robert-Gerwig-Strasse (Radio-7 chicane not modelled), then east on the northern carriageway to a hairpin across the central reservation (bridged; exact position unverified).
